name: Modern Woodworks
old_description: While many houses may be similar, it's the differences that make them a home. Give Modern Woodworks the opportunity to achieve your goals of creating the home you always wanted. With years of experience improving the homes of our community, we combine skilled craftsmanship with hard-working dedication to give your project the attention and care it deserves. Call Modern Woodworks today for a consultation, and we'll figure out the best way to make your dream home or office a reality.
about:
Modern Woodworks is based in Kenmare, North Dakota, where owner Shane and his crew provide custom woodworking and installation services for homes and offices. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it emphasizes a hands-on approach built on skilled craftsmanship and hard-working dedication.

The shop produces a range of architectural millwork and custom cabinetry, including entryways, doors, built-in units, bars, columns, kitchen and bathroom cabinets, crown molding, trim, wainscoting, ceiling treatments, and fireplace surrounds. Work is fabricated and installed by the same team, allowing control over fit and finish from design through final installation. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Modern Woodworks primarily serves residential homeowners undertaking remodels or new construction, as well as commercial clients seeking custom office interiors. Projects referenced in testimonials include kitchen renovations and whole-house woodwork packages, indicating a focus on high-detail interior finish work.

The company states that it combines skilled craftsmanship with hard-working dedication to give each project the attention and care it deserves. Customer reviews highlight honesty, a willingness to stand behind the work, and clean installation practices as distinguishing traits.
